subject.title: the rendered-quality gate has never been able to run, and nothing said why
subject.text: The campaign names design-review and be-my-witness as gates and has never run either, and the reason was never measured — it read as a skip. It is not. be-my-witness 0.2.0's deterministic prescan over all 16 pairs that hold both halves reports isEvidence 16/16, settled 16/16, framingComparable 0/16, proceed 0/16. Not a dead predicate: the scale ratios differ per lane (0.466x on the SURF-001 sidebar crop, 1.64x on the Mac boards, 0.942x on the phone) rather than returning a constant. Every reference was rasterised at a 1280x720 dpr-1 viewport, inside which prototype.html draws a fixed artboard rather than filling the frame, so rendering larger pads rather than enlarges. Re-rendering the reference does not fix it either: the design's Mac window is #win at 1156x680, aspect 1.700, and the build's is 980x620, aspect 1.581. The build half crops exactly — scale=(2096-1376)/(980-620)=2.0, margin=(2096-980*2)/2=68, content rect (68,68,1960,1240), precisely 2x the AX frame — but no crop reconciles two different window shapes. What would make them comparable is re-capturing the app at the design's window size, which means driving the app again and photographing a window shape the product does not use. Left unresolved deliberately: the structural and lexical differential in evidence/differential.md is the comparison that is valid here, and it ran.
